title: project.json
description: Project-level defaults (§5.3). Everything here can be overridden per run on the command line; nothing here describes the story.

silence_lead_policy.description: trim discards leading silence so the handle is exactly head_handle_s; keep leaves the recording untouched and lengthens the shot instead.

cache_dir.description: Where this project's artifact store lives. null (or absent) means <project>/.cache. A relative path is resolved against the project root; $PIPELINE_CACHE_DIR overrides this. The store is the only part of a project that grows without bound, so on a full or cloud-synced drive it has to be able to live elsewhere.
